channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Steve Ballmer | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Steve Ballmer from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Trent Redden on Steve Ballmer, Jonathan Gibson
item.description:
“Ty's input on the player level and his system is always part of it. I don't see that changing because of the [suspensions]. We'll just talk to [Gibson] for final approval [of trades] instead of talking to [Ballmer].”

Trent Redden on Steve Ballmer, Jonathan Gibson, Sep 28, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Ryan Smith:

“On a personal level, Steve (Ballmer) has been so awesome to me over the years. One of the first phone calls I had when I came in, knew him from tech, and you know, he's a stand-up individual first and foremost. This game's tricky, this game's hard, and obviously we have rules and the NBA's got to do it. And you know, I'm glad he accepted it and we all can just turn the page and move on. But it's not the first time this has happened in the league. But I think that we've got these rules have to mean anything. As owners, we're held to a pretty high standard comparatively.”

Ryan Smith on Steve Ballmer, Sep 23, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Ballmer, Adam Silver
item.description:
“I think the reason the investigation took as long as it did and the idea that Steve Ballmer, who I’ve gotten to know and I know he’s a great guy, is standing by the punishment– there’s a reason that it’s happened all the way it has. And at the end of the day, Adam Silver had a job to do, and I think the punishment makes sense, and we all move forward.”

Stephen Curry on Steve Ballmer, Adam Silver, Sep 17, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Pablo Torre on Steve Ballmer, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Torre said on the Dan Patrick Show.

“And the NBA said, well in that case, we’re going to do something that perhaps caught Steve Ballmer by surprise. They found a way to settle with Kawhi Leonard and the Players’ Union…They got Kawhi to settle.”

Pablo Torre on Steve Ballmer, Kawhi Leonard, Sep 3, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Pablo Torre on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“When the NBA tried to settle with Steve Ballmer, and they said, ‘Hey we have a narrow scope, we have undeniable evidence, we want to just make sure that you have the opportunity to take your punishment, admit wrongdoing, and let us all move on.’ Steve Ballmer — according to everything that we’ve seen now play out in public after that ESPN story two weeks ago — decided to fight,”

Pablo Torre on Steve Ballmer, Sep 3, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“All of Ballmer’s (invested) money is gone. You would think that if there was a deal that was made between Ballmer and anybody, anybody with half a brain would set aside that money.”

Mark Cuban on Steve Ballmer, Oct 14, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Bradley Beal on choosing the Clippers over other teams:

“It wasn't an easy decision... This, in particular, stuck out a lot. One, who Steve Ballmer is, how he operates, and what he stands for... Their pitch was honestly just better.”

Bradley Beal on Steve Ballmer, Sep 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Channing Frye on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
When the topic was first mentioned during the episode, Frye started the segment by questioning the motive behind Torre’s investigation, per ESPN’s Road Trippin.

“First of all, why you snitchin? Who cares? Do you know how much this lemon perfect bottle was? Probably 28 cents. This is what Steve Ballmer thinks of $28 million. He’s oh, here you go. You want this? He don’t care,”

Channing Frye on Steve Ballmer, Sep 13, 2025. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Lonzo Ball on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Lonzo Ball:

“Shoutout to Ballmer. He’s very thoughtful thinking of the away team. We appreciate that.”

Lonzo Ball on Steve Ballmer, Jan 21, 2025. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Paul George on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“I think it got kind of misconstrued or [the] narrative kind of wasn't written correctly with the relationship with Lawrence [Frank], the relationship with Steve Ballmer,”

Paul George on Steve Ballmer, Nov 6, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Kevin Durant:

“Steve Ballmer did a great job with this arena. It’s incredible. Probably the best one I’ve been in. It’s good to have two L.A. teams with their own arenas.”

Kevin Durant on Steve Ballmer, Oct 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: James Worthy on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“I'm happy to see that their owner, [Steve] Ballmer, has taken a lot of interest in the city of Inglewood, creating jobs and housing,”

James Worthy on Steve Ballmer, Sep 8, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“His owner is here in Seattle, Mr. Ballmer’s here in Seattle, so we thought it was a no-brainer. We’re just glad we were able to get it together and here they are.”

Tyronn Lue on Steve Ballmer, Oct 3, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Bill Walton on Lawrence Frank, Tyronn Lue, Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Bill Walton:

“The culture he has built, Steve Ballmer, he bought the Clippers when they were a farce and now they are the authorial standard of excellence. You've got Lawrence Frank running the show, Ty Lue coaching it, you've got the players, it is just fantastic. We couldn't be happier, we couldn't be more proud, they've got the new arena coming. Yeah, the future, woah!”

Bill Walton on Lawrence Frank, Tyronn Lue, Steve Ballmer, Aug 20, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Bill Walton on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Walton was attending the event to support the Pump family's mission to help eradicate cancer through donations that allow extra research funding.

“To see what the Clippers have become with Steve Ballmer, who is the epitome of a great leader, this guy is just fantastic,”

Bill Walton on Steve Ballmer, Aug 20, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Lawrence Frank, Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“My familiarity with the organization, particularly Mr. Ballmer and Lawrence, confirmed this is where I want to be. We have work to do to become champions, but we have the motivation, the tools, and the support to get there. I’m excited to get started.”

Tyronn Lue on Lawrence Frank, Steve Ballmer, Oct 20, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Clipper Darrell on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
The Clippers also won the first regular-season meeting between the teams, 112-102, sans George, on opening night.

“It’s the Steve Ballmer-era. No egos. It’s our time. June 2020, let’s go,”

Clipper Darrell on Steve Ballmer, Dec 26, 2019. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“He comes into this meeting and he shakes our hands and he’s talking. We were prepared for a meeting where we would have to drag things out of him. Instead, he’s the one talking and finally he tells us exactly what the deal is.“He said, ‘I want to play for you,’ and he pointed at me. He said, ‘Mr. Ballmer, I love the things you do and what you stand for, but your team is not good enough and if you don’t change your team, I’m not coming.’”

Doc Rivers on Steve Ballmer, Sep 19, 2019. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Chris Paul on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“I’ll tell you one thing when Ballmer sat down there, everyone was all ears. My hope is that’s something we can keep implementing in our league and just try to continue that dialogue. I think guys would definitely listen to the owners and CEOs of their teams who’ve dealt with that type of money.”

Chris Paul on Steve Ballmer, Jul 21, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“Steve Ballmer (Clippers owner) was in the room and I think it was the most impressive interview we ever had in the times I've done it. He's long, he already has great touch, he shoots the ball pretty well. He's going to be a good player.”

Doc Rivers on Steve Ballmer, Nov 3, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Doc on Ballmer in meeting:

“Steve was great. He was involved but he let everyone else do more talking.”

Doc Rivers on Steve Ballmer, Jul 9, 2015. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Serena Winters:Jeanie Buss on if she was happy when the Clippers lost:

“No not at all. I feel that Steve Ballmer is a great owner...great for the league.”

Jeanie Buss on Steve Ballmer, May 19, 2015. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Chris Hansen on Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Steve Ballmer acknowledged earlier in the day that he has entered into an agreement to purchase the NBA’s Los Angeles Clippers.

“First, I would like to congratulate Steve Ballmer on his apparent successful bid for the Los Angeles Clippers. Steve's passion for basketball and commitment to the NBA will make him a great owner and strong asset for the league,”

Chris Hansen on Steve Ballmer, May 31, 2014. Source: king5.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on Steve Ballmer, Chris Hansen
item.description:
And Silver replied:

“Iwould never say it’s never going to happen. There’s nothing in the works at the moment. We were very clear when we were going through the issue with Steve Ballmer and Mr. Hansen that expansion was not in the cards right now.”

Adam Silver on Steve Ballmer, Chris Hansen, Sep 12, 2013. Source: Seattle Times.
